name: Evanston Qualifier 2026
information: **3x3 will *not* be held at this competition!** This competition provides one last chance to set qualifying times for the [WCA North American Championship](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/NAC2026) in July. Please read all tabs before registering. If you have not been to Northwestern before, allow at least 15 extra minutes to locate the venue. Each competitor may register for at most 6 events. This competition is supported by the [Midwest Cubing Association](https://midwestcubing.org). ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBbVZoIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--1b3d9004e1f9dfdbe319a8f4bd8117aa0a47de6b/image.png)
